content.title: Why This Topic Needs More Context
content.left_text: Our current plan is clear at a high level, but teams still need shared context on assumptions, dependencies, and expected outcomes. This first column explains the background so decisions are easier to understand and align across functions.
content.right_text: With that foundation in place, the second column continues with practical implications: what changes next, where coordination is required, and how success will be measured. This keeps the narrative complete without overloading a single text area.
